IMPORTANT: User rejected overly simplified, flat, 6-color icons. Restore the rich TGMC rendering: crisp 1-pixel carapace ridges, distinct limbs, layered exoskeleton plates, contrasting hard highlights, readable claw tips and face, 12-18 carefully chosen colors.
